mapper.insert: INSERT INTO pms_category(name, parent_id, depth, keywords, sort, icon, enable, is_parent, is_display, gmt_create, gmt_modified) VALUES(#{name}, #{parentId}, #{depth}, #{keywords}, #{sort}, #{icon}, #{enable}, #{isParent}, #{isDisplay}, #{gmtCreate}, #{gmtModified})
mapper.select: SELECT id, parent_id AS parentId, name, keywords, sort, enable, depth, is_parent AS isParent FROM pms_category ORDER BY sort
SELECT id, parent_id AS parentId, name, keywords, sort, enable, depth, is_parent AS isParent FROM pms_category WHERE id=#{id}
SELECT id, parent_id AS parentId, name, keywords, sort, enable, depth, is_parent AS isParent FROM pms_category WHERE parent_id=#{parentId} ORDER BY sort, id
